name: esm-hookjack-dep
description: ESM test fixture dependency (vendored, committed) for issues #61 and #181: tries to register its own module-customization hook so that mediated specifiers resolve straight to the raw node: URL, by every route a dependency has to node:module's registration APIs (named export, the Module class, require().Module, module.constructor, process.getBuiltinModule). Inert per AGENTS.md § 8 — the hooks only rewrite a specifier; nothing is read, spawned or sent.
